sample.task: Generate 30 messages in Russian from the online lesson chat so that they correspond to at least one of the following labels: swearing (obscene language), technical difficulties (problems with sound, video, equipment, access to materials, computer text with a message about error) and level of understanding of the lesson (for example, messages that the lesson material is difficult or requires additional explanation). Generate 5 messages that have multiple labels.
